Premium leather and Vault CE rated armor at the elbows, shoulder and back allow the Speed and Strength Dark Horse Jacket provide protection no matter what you're riding. Shoulder expansion gussets make it easy to reach for the bars and a concealed carry pocket makes it easy to reach for your piece.

  • Premium leather frame

  • Removable Vault CE approved back protector
